name: mit-trader-skill
description: The MIT Trader skill: MIT OpenCourseWare's quant finance course as Claude skills

plugins.name: mit-trader-skill
plugins.description: Fourteen Claude skills built on MIT 18.S096: a statistical scanner, a regression signal lab, GARCH volatility, Monte Carlo odds, factor models, Kelly sizing and portfolio optimization, Value at Risk, a risk gate, a broker step (paper by default, never without your yes), pairs trading, options math, optimal execution, an autopilot and a professor.
